sloka: चकम्पे मेदिनी कृत्स्ना सशैलवनकानना ।भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चासीन्न ववौ चापि मारुतः ।। ६.११०.१९ ।।
transliteration: cakampe medinī kṛtsnā saśailavanakānanā ।bhāskaro niṣprabhaścāsīnna vavau cāpi mārutaḥ ।। 6.110.19 ।।

translations.english: The entire globe with its mountains, gardens and forests shook, the Sun lost his radiance, even the wind did not blow.
